llm.summary: This skill is a focused SEO indexing checker that uses a disclosed SEOmatic connection to read Search Console data and stage user-approved fixes.

dimensions.detail: No local binaries, environment variables, scripts, package installs, or broad filesystem access are requested; data access is limited to the connected SEOmatic/Search Console workflow.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It requires the SEOmatic MCP server over streamable HTTP with OAuth or a Bearer API key, which is disclosed in the skill metadata and setup instructions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The workflow is bounded to user-named or important site pages, uses Search Console data rather than guesses, and explicitly avoids unsupported indexing promises.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill can stage SEOmatic tasks and later approve specific tasks only after user consent; it explicitly says not to approve on the user's behalf and requires extra confirmation for destructive noindex or redirect tasks.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to inspect Google indexing status, explain causes, check sitemaps, and stage SEO fixes; the declared tools and instructions directly support that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be comfortable connecting SEOmatic to your Search Console data and review any staged tasks, estimated costs, and destructive changes before approving them.
